keySentence: The beanstalk grew up very high.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The beanstalk was huge. Jack started to climb. He went up and up. The beanstalk grew up very high.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack decided to climb the enormous beanstalk. The beanstalk grew up very high into the clouds. He climbed one step at a time, holding on tightly. The wind was blowing hard and his house looked tiny below. Jack was scared but his curiosity was even stronger. He kept climbing toward the mysterious cloud above.
